headline:
وضع New Game Plus قادم
إلى Valhalla في 5 نوفمبر
label: رسمي
note: Primary: Ubisoft, 'Assassin's Creed: Fall 2026 Update' (ubisoft.com news MW9NJgNmVSPHu2AVCFHH9, 29 Oct 2026), read in full 21:31Z: Valhalla passed 40 million players; New Game+ arrives November 5; no other AC remake actively in development; Codename Hexe next major update in 2027; Black Flag Resynced final major update out. Footage: Valhalla Accolade trailer (Steam 2208920, 1920x1072; the Story trailer is letterboxed to 800 rows; Steam's HLS copy fails the decode check, so the clean stretches without burnt-in subtitles or review quotes, 0.0-9.06, 46.3-59.9 and 68.7-71.0, were cut from the DASH copy into live/2026-10-30/ac-update/acv-cut.mp4, crf 14, decode clean) and Black Flag Resynced Gameplay Trailer (Steam 3751950). Sound: Black Flag gameplay trailer from 10.0 s, music, no speech (faster-whisper found none); the Valhalla trailer is voiced throughout and is not used for sound. Valhalla accolade stretches carry their own narration; only the picture is used. pace_ok: each shot is a continuous trailer stretch with its own cuts inside (accolade 46.3-51.7 cuts at 47.2, 47.9, 48.9, 49.9, 50.5; Black Flag 12.25-17.25 cuts at 14.3, 15.7, 16.75; accolade 53.3-58.2 dissolves), so the picture changes every 1 to 2 s.
